steps.title: Where the network stands
steps.body: Four instruments summarise service, groundings, capital and cost — baseline policy versus the recommendation, each with its uncertainty.

steps.title: Risk by aircraft system
steps.body: Each ATA zone on the schematic glows by the share of high-risk part numbers it contains. Select one to open Parts Intelligence.

steps.title: Part-level evidence
steps.body: Demand class, stock by station and a risk score for every fictional part number.

steps.title: Where the stock sits
steps.body: The hub at AUH supports six outstations. Arcs show AOG transport times and transfer volumes.

steps.title: Capital versus groundings
steps.body: Every dot is a stocking plan. The frontier shows the lowest AOG hours reachable for each capital level.
